LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingEnginesStart: Aircraft engines start one after another

On by default: an aircraft's turbine engines light one after another once it is told to start, a few seconds each at normal speed, and it may not take off until all are running. Aircraft that already spool up before take-off keep their own. Takes effect at once.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_EnginesStarting: {VEHICLE}'s engines are still starting, one after another: {LIT} of {ENGINES} running.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_StripDebris: Stones thrown up from the rough ground have struck {VEHICLE}'s {PART}.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_CrossFeedCrewOpened: {VEHICLE}'s crew opened the fuel cross-feed: the good tank now feeds both engines, and the leak drains it too.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_EngineStarved: {VEHICLE}: the tank feeding {ENGINE} has run dry, and what it feeds has stopped. Open the cross-feed to feed it from the other side.
